title: Chemical Peel in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) | SOLAR
descr: Chemical peel in Dubai at a licensed clinic in Sobha Hartland. PRX-T33 with no peeling and no downtime, superficial peels. Free consultation.

hero.8: Chemical Peel in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) - Even Tone and Glow Without Weeks of Recovery
hero.7: A chemical peel removes the dull, damaged upper layer of the skin and pushes renewal from within: tone evens out, pores look smaller, fine lines soften. In a city with strong sun all year round we build the protocol around safety - superficial peels and PRX-T33, which works as a peel without the flaking and without downtime.
hero.0: Face, neck, decollete. 30-45 minutes, back to your day the same afternoon.

what.10: A chemical face peel is a controlled application of acids that dissolve the bonds between dead cells on the surface of the skin and signal the deeper layers to renew.
what.9: The skin sheds what it no longer needs and rebuilds collagen in response. Depth is what separates one peel treatment from another: a superficial peel works within the epidermis, a medium depth peel reaches the upper dermis.
what.6: Glycolic, mandelic and salicylic acids in low concentrations. Light freshening, minimal or no visible flaking, safe to repeat in a course. This is the workhorse of peeling in Dubai.
what.3: Higher concentrations, including TCA peel protocols, reach the upper dermis and work on deeper pigmentation and post-acne texture. Stronger effect, real recovery time, strict sun rules afterwards.
what.0: A combination of TCA with hydrogen peroxide and kojic acid that stimulates the dermis without damaging the surface. No flaking, no social downtime, and the one protocol we can run comfortably through the Dubai summer.

benefits.13: Why a chemical peel remains the most direct way to change skin quality rather than just hydrate it.
benefits.10: The most visible change after the first sessions: dullness lifts, the complexion looks lighter and more uniform, makeup sits better.
benefits.7: Salicylic acid is fat soluble, so it works inside the pore: fewer blackheads, less shine by the middle of the day.
benefits.3: Fine lines, post-acne roughness and uneven relief smooth out gradually as collagen synthesis picks up.
benefits.0: With PRX-T33 there is nothing to hide: no flaking, no redness to wait out, you can go straight back to work or to dinner.

whyTitle.1: Depth matters more than the brand of the acid
whyTitle.0: The name on the bottle matters far less than four things the doctor checks before your first chemical peel treatment.

whyCards.9: Superficial, medium or a no-peeling protocol like PRX-T33. Depth decides both the result and the risk; going deeper than the skin needs buys nothing and costs recovery time.
whyCards.6: Darker phototypes respond well to peels but are more prone to post-inflammatory pigmentation. That is an argument for gentler acids, lower concentrations and a longer course, not for skipping the treatment.
whyCards.3: UV levels here stay high all year. Aggressive peels in the middle of summer are a real risk of pigmentation, which is why we lean towards superficial protocols and PRX-T33 and keep the stronger options for the cooler months.
whyCards.0: A peel is half the work. Without daily SPF 50, gentle cleansing and the right actives at home, the tone you gained comes back within weeks.

evTitle.0: Chemical peels are among the oldest and best documented methods in dermatology, with a large body of clinical literature behind them.

evCards.12: Controlled comparisons of superficial peels in melasma and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation report improvement in pigment scores over a course of sessions, with better tolerance at lower concentrations.
evCards.7: Trials of salicylic and glycolic peels in mild to moderate acne describe reduction in inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions across repeated sessions.
evCards.2: Reviews of medium depth peels for photoaged skin report smoother texture and evidence of collagen remodelling, alongside a longer recovery period and a strict requirement for sun protection.
evCards.0: The studies refer to the method (chemical peels), not to a specific clinic. Results are individual and depend on skin type, depth of the peel and home care.

indTitle.0: From a dull complexion to seasonal skin renewal.

indItems.0: Deeper scarring is a separate task: see Acne Scar Treatment.

steps.13: The doctor examines the skin, checks phototype, current products and contraindications, and decides which depth is appropriate right now. A 3D Skin Test Janus III diagnostic can be added to see pigment and pores objectively.
steps.9: Cleansing and degreasing. For some protocols a short home preparation with mild acids is recommended in the weeks before.
steps.5: The acid is applied in layers and neutralised on time, or PRX-T33 is massaged in until the skin responds. 30-45 minutes with a warm or tingling sensation that fades quickly.
steps.2: After care and the next session
steps.1: Soothing care and SPF 50 the same day, then a course of 4-6 sessions with 2-4 week intervals, depending on the protocol.
steps.0: Good to know: for the first days avoid sauna, hammam, the pool, scrubs and retinol, and do not pick at flaking skin. SPF 50 every morning is not optional in Dubai.

results.3: Pigmentation fades, pores look tighter, texture becomes noticeably smoother. This is where a course starts to pay off.
results.0: With a completed course and daily sun protection the result holds for months. Most clients repeat a short course seasonally, usually in the cooler part of the year.

faq: It depends on the depth. After a superficial peel there may be light flaking for 2-4 days, after a medium depth peel more. PRX-T33 does not cause flaking at all, which is why it is the most requested option here.
Can I have a peel in the summer in Dubai?

Yes, but not any peel. In the hot months we work with superficial protocols and PRX-T33 and postpone stronger medium depth peels to the cooler season. Daily SPF 50 is required either way, indoors and out.
How many sessions do I need?

Usually 4-6 with 2-4 week intervals. One session gives a fresh look before an event; a lasting change in tone and texture comes from a course. The price of the course depends on the protocol and the zones and is agreed at the free consultation.
Is a chemical peel suitable for darker skin?

Yes, with the right choice of acid and concentration. Darker phototypes are more prone to post-inflammatory pigmentation, so we start gentler, go slower and never push the depth further than the skin needs.
What should I avoid after a peel?
For the first days: sun without SPF 50, sauna and hammam, the pool, scrubs, retinol and acids at home, and picking at flaking skin. The doctor gives you a short written list after the session.
What is the price of a chemical peel in Dubai?
The price depends on the zones, the protocol and the number of sessions you need. It is agreed at the free consultation with the doctor, before anything is booked, and there are no hidden extras.

How much does a chemical peel cost in Dubai?

At SOLAR in Dubai the chemical peel price depends on the protocol, the number of zones and whether you take a single session or a course. The doctor chooses the depth after examining your skin, and the price is agreed at a free consultation, before anything is booked.

  • PRX-T33 therapy, face. A peel without peeling: no flaking, no downtime, suitable all year round.
  • PRX-T33 therapy, face and neck. The neck ages faster than the face and rarely gets the same care.
  • PRX-T33 therapy, face, neck and decollete. The full open-skin zone in one session.
  • PRX-T33 therapy, back. For texture and post-acne marks on the back.
  • Glycolic, salicylic or mandelic peel, face. Usually a course of 4-6 sessions.
  • Deep cleansing facial with manual extraction. Often the right first step before a peel course if pores are congested.
  • HYDROPEPTIDE Radiance Glow Facial. A gentle acid-based glow protocol with no recovery time.
  • HYDROPEPTIDE Miracle Facial. Renewal and hydration in one session.
  • 3D Skin Test Janus III diagnostic, 30 minutes. Objective assessment of pigment, pores and hydration before choosing the depth.

What changes the price

  • Protocol and depth: a superficial peel and a medium depth peel are different products with different costs and different recovery.
  • Number of zones: face only, or face with neck and decollete.
  • Single session or a course: a course of 4-6 sessions gives a result that a single peel treatment cannot.
  • Preparation and after care: home products are chosen individually and are not included in the session price.

There are no hidden extras: the consultation is free and the price is agreed with you before the treatment starts.
